reasoning_content: The build started - let me check for the APK file.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Wait for build and check
import time
time.sleep(60)

# Check if APK exists
c.exec_command("find /opt/areloria/client/android -name '*.apk' 2>/dev/null")

print("Checking APK...")
stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/client/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'not yet'")

print("Result:", stdout.read().decode())

c.close()
EOF
